artifact_scope: Fixed equation and frozen shared parameters; no optimizer or validation scorer
initialization: One externally supplied initial temperature per independent legal segment; no later output correction
input_timing: inputs[k] is held constant over transition from states[k] to states[k+1]
numerical_update: T_next = T + (-expm1(-H*dt/C_eff)/H)*q(T,u), H=UA_amb+(flow/flow_ref)*UA_water; H=0 uses dt*q/C_eff
tank_proxy: Tank-water boundary proxy, not measured collector inlet; OFF does not require tank temperature
ambient_proxy: Gridded 2 m ambient-air-temperature proxy, not onsite measurement
electrical_term: gamma_Pel=1 heat subtraction is a model assumption
flow_evidence: Prescribed 0/500 settings, not a measured flow time series; other flow settings rejected
observation_approximation: Frozen 60 s mean panel temperature treated as an effective state at the window label

historical_fit.objective: equal-day mean segment free-run MSE, excluding initialization

physical_interpretation: Effective fitted parameters, not established invariant material or heat-transfer properties
continuity: Caller must supply reviewed independent segments; a simulation segment cannot change flow
